verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is a SaaS research product that could plausibly expose an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no public API, OpenAPI spec, or other machine-readable spec available for download. The only exports documented are user content (notes to Docs/Sheets, flashcards as CSV, infographics as PNG, slides as PDF), and none of these is an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
